As a new customer I want to:
OPEN AN ACCOUNT
Open an Account
If you don’t have an existing account, then you will need to fill out new account paperwork to set up the account. This document also contains the membership application.
Download new account and membership application >
Your membership status will depend on whether you are involved in agricultural production. If you are, then you will be classified as a voting member, and receive patronage based on the business done with Kanza. You will be eligible to vote on business matters (such as board of director candidates) for the cooperative at the annual meeting in April.
If you are not an ag producer, you will be a non-voting member. You can’t vote but you can do business with Kanza and earn patronage, which can be a combination of cash and/or equity in the cooperative.
BECOME A MEMBER
Become a Member
If you already have an account established with Kanza Cooperative, then all you need to do to become a member is to fill out the membership application with payment of $25.
Download membership application >
If you don’t have an existing account, then you will need to fill out new account paperwork to set up the account. This document also contains the membership application.
Download new account and membership application >
Your membership status will depend on whether you are involved in agricultural production. If you are, then you will be classified as a voting member, and receive patronage based on the business done with Kanza. You will be eligible to vote on business matters (such as board of director candidates) for the cooperative at the annual meeting in April.
If you are not an ag producer, you will be a non-voting member. You can’t vote but you can do business with Kanza and earn patronage, which can be a combination of cash and/or equity in the cooperative.
SET UP ELECTRONIC PAYMENT
Set up electronic payment
If you receive grain payments from Kanza Cooperative or make payments on your account, you can complete a form that allows monthly recurring ACH payments, or you can schedule one-time payments through the Patron Access Portal.  Download ACH form >
GET A PATRON ACCESS PORTAL ONLINE ACCOUNT
Get a Patron Access Portal online account
To set up your online account, you can go to  Kanzacoop.com>Patron Access>Sign-up and fill out the form, or you can email us your request at   AR@kanzacoop.com .
As an existing customer I want to:
APPLY FOR FINANCING
Apply for Financing
Kanza Cooperative offers convenience credit for ongoing purchases and financing for crop inputs.
Convenience credit
To obtain a Kanza Card or Cardtrol Card, you need to open an account by filling out a credit application and reviewing a charge account agreement. Once approved, your card may be used at any of our fuel pumps and at our convenience stores. You receive a 2-cent per gallon discount on fuel. See our charge account agreement for payment terms.
Download credit application >
Download charge account agreement >
Crop input financing 
We offer financing for low fixed interest rates and maturity dates that help you take advantage of valuable crop marketing and tax benefits.
Single page application to save you time.
Low APR financing terms combined with an extended maturity allowing you to make payments on principal after harvest.
Can be applied to qualifying purchases fertilizer, seed and crop protection products.
Kanza Financing Program >
Talk to an agronomy representative at Kanza Cooperative for more information on this financing option.
REQUEST PROPANE/FUEL DELIVERY
Request Propane/Fuel Delivery
Submit a request for propane, bulk fuel or bulk oil to get set up for your next delivery.
Delivery Request
UPDATE MY ACCOUNT/CONTACT INFORMATION
Update My Account/Contact Information
Email any updates of contact or account information to AR@kanzacoop.com . You can also call Tonya Harris at (620) 352-9850 or Monica Lubbers (620) 352-9844 to make updates.
GO PAPERLESS
Go Paperless
Customers can opt out of receiving a printed copy of monthly statements. Save paper by signing up for paperless delivery through email. To go paperless, email AR@kanzacoop.com or contact any member of the accounting department.
CHECK MY EQUITY BALANCE
Check My Equity Balance
Please call Mickaela Holmes at (316) 874-6513. She will provide you the most current information.
GET TAX EXEMPTION FOR MY AGRICULTURAL PURCHASES
Get Tax Exemption for my Agricultural Purchases
Customers wanting to get tax exemption on agricultural purchases need to complete the tax exempt form and submit it to salestax@kanzacoop.com . The form can also be dropped off at any Kanza location or mailed to Kanza Attn: Sales Tax, 220 Main Street, Andale, KS 67001. Contact Robin Bell (620) 352-9836 with questions about sales tax exemption.
SETTLE AN ESTATE
Settle an Estate
To settle an estate, you must first speak with Mickaela Holmes at Kanza Cooperative. She will ask you some relevant questions regarding the account and your request. Based on the information you provide we will determine the next steps.
Some factors we need to understand and documentation needed include:
Is the account in the name of an individual or trust?
If the individual has an estate, you will need to provide a copy of the Letters Testamentary from the court.
If a trust, you will need to provide a certification of trust.
You’ll also need to provide a death certificate.
Finally, you must write a letter to the board of directors to formally request the equity payout. This letter should be sent to Mickaela Holmes, Kanza Coop, PO Box 175, Iuka, KS 67066.
Additional information also may be requested by Kanza Cooperative Association.
Finally, you must write a letter to the board of directors to formally request the equity payout. This letter should be sent to Mickaela Holmes, Kanza Coop, PO Box 175, Iuka, KS 67066.
Requests must be approved by the board of directors. Once the board has approved the request, payment will typically be made within a week.
REQUEST A DONATION
Request a Donation
Kanza Cooperative Association is a proud supporter of activities that make our communities and people stronger. Organizations and individuals requesting donations or sponsorships should complete this online form.
Complete online form here >
PATRON ACCESS
Patron Access
Information about your Kanza account is available online through our Patron Access portal. The portal give you easy access, 24/7 to all your information including statements, account history and prepaid details.
Patron Access Portal

Order Pizza

As a vendor I want to:
GET SET-UP AS A VENDOR
Get Set-Up as a Vendor
We’re proud of the relationships we have with our vendors, and we work alongside them to best serve the needs of our members. To become a vendor of Kanza Cooperative, you will need to review and/or complete a few forms.
To complete this form you will need the following:
Information to complete W-9 form
Bank information to complete ACH authorization form
A/R contact information
Freight Ve ndors: Email certificate of insurance to rmccoy@kanzacoop.com.
Complete vendor application.
